answer_1.quote: Closed-source models such as o3 and Gemini 2.5 show notable gains when generating structured explanations alongside label predictions.
answer_1.outputs: fact-checking label and structured explanatory triplets

answer_2.quote: We further evaluate generated triplets using BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L and BERTScore. We evaluate label classification using accuracy and macro F1.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a manual evaluation of 50 chart-totable conversions, sampled across five chart types. Each output was assessed according to three criteria: fidelity to the original chart, omission of relevant information, and presence of hallucinated content.
answer_4.guideline: Assess each generated table for fidelity, omission/misread, and hallucination.
